title: S2 producer receipt: three-field verdict (C1) and authority-stage record (C4)
objective: Implement the receipt producer: immutable receipt records carrying the plan s3 receipt fields, the three-field verdict and the gate authority-stage record with its inheritance rule.
problem: Contract section B. C1: execution {RAN; BLOCKED with what was missing}, authority {QUALIFIED at stage X; UNQUALIFIED with why}, outcome; eligibility = worst of the three; all three always present. C4: author-tested | first-sight challenged (date, cases, edits, denominators, score) | closed after repair; a claim inherits the lowest stage among its gates. At S2 every gate is author-tested.
non_goals: Do not copy code, tests or verdict policies from the Fable or ASTRA harnesses; they are reference and adversarial corpora (SOURCES.md B; NEXT_ROUND_PLAN_v0.4 s1)
Python >= 3.8 standard library only; no package installation (MWO-0004 R2)
evidence_required: RED: tests for missing-field rejection and lowest-stage inheritance fail before implementation
GREEN: a receipt cannot be constructed without all three fields; inheritance picks the lowest stage; a cheat control: a receipt claiming QUALIFIED with an author-tested gate is refused

acceptance.condition: receipt tests pass including the cheat control
